categories.main_business_segments: Jing-Jin Electric Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, sales, and service of electric drive systems for new energy vehicles (NEVs). Its main product lines include electric drive motor assemblies, controllers, transmission assemblies, and related energy storage systems. The company also provides technical development and services, including synchronous development, technical service, and mold development for automotive clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies in high-efficiency electric motors using rectangular conductors and amorphous materials, oil cooling technology, integrated motor and transmission assemblies, electromagnetic clutches, and third-generation silicon carbide semiconductor controllers. It emphasizes system-level integration with multi-in-one electric drive systems, including high-power density and high-torque density designs. Production methods include precision mechanical processing, real-time software control algorithms, and lean manufacturing with a focus on quality, cost control, and delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jing-Jin Electric serves leading global and domestic automotive manufacturers, including Stellantis Group, Ford, FAW, BAIC, SAIC, GAC, Chery, XPeng, BYD, Yutong, Foton, Zhongtong, Qingling, and Dongfeng. Its products cater to passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and electric motorcycles. The company also targets emerging overseas markets, particularly North America and Europe, and non-automotive new energy electric drive system markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production and R&D bases in Beijing, Shanghai, Zhengding, Heze, and overseas in Detroit, USA. Its sales and services cover domestic markets extensively and international markets including North America and Europe. Overseas business is expanding with localized production and R&D facilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jing-Jin Electric operates as a core upstream and midstream supplier in the NEV supply chain, providing integrated electric drive systems and components directly to OEMs. It holds a strategic position as a first-tier supplier of powertrain and control components, engaging in early-stage co-development with vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes original, autonomous, and forward-looking R&D focusing on high-end electric drive systems, including multi-in-one integrated systems, third-generation semiconductor controllers, oil-cooled motors, electromagnetic clutches, and energy storage optimization. It invests heavily in innovation to maintain technological leadership and expand product applications across passenger and commercial vehicles and non-automotive sectors. R&D efforts also emphasize software safety, thermal management, and system integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electric drive systems and related components to automotive OEMs and commercial vehicle manufacturers. The company also earns income from technical development and service contracts, including synchronous development, mold development, and technical support. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales with some consignment (consignment warehouse) arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jing-Jin Electric is positioned as a leading domestic electric drive system supplier with international recognition, holding strategic first-tier supplier status to major global OEMs. It competes with other NEV electric drive system manufacturers, including BYD (which has stable in-house supply) and international suppliers. The company leverages its advanced technology, early market entry, and system integration capabilities to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jing-Jin Electric reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.3 billion, a 50.64% increase year-over-year, driven by strong growth in passenger and commercial vehicle electric drive system sales and technical services. Despite revenue growth, the company remained unprofitable with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 436 million, though the loss narrowed compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.57 billion with net assets of RMB 580 million at year-end. Cash flow from operations turned positive, reflecting improved sales and collections.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced, highly integrated electric drive systems with superior efficiency, power density, torque density, reliability, and low noise. Its proprietary technologies, such as the direct-flux dual bistable electromagnetic clutch and oil-water composite cooling, differentiate its products. Jing-Jin Electric offers system-level solutions with deep integration of motor, controller, and transmission, enabling lighter, more efficient, and cost-effective powertrains. Its strong R&D capabilities and international certifications support its value proposition of delivering world-class electric drive systems tailored to high-end NEV markets.
